last_summary: Current evidence is projected. Video 2 shows a body/chassis assembly followed by chassis manipulation and interior-component adjustment, which is the most consistent with an unnecessary detach/rework during assembly. Video 1 and Video 3 evidence mainly supports attachment actions and does not provide a stronger comparable candidate. R01/R02 remain partially ambiguous, but additional local probes are not expected to overturn the best-supported choice.
review_reason: Evidence from indices 15-17 confirms continued chassis manipulation but fails to resolve whether the specific action was a reversal of a previous separation or a standard assembly step due to ambiguity in the visual sequence.
